from store import Store
from setup import begin_setup, complete_setup, active_connection
from cleanup import cleanup_setup
store = Store()
# Setup A begins, job fails but cleanup is queued
begin_setup(store, "w", "A")
# Another setup B completes before A cleanup runs (README: this can happen)
complete_setup(store, "w", "B", "connection-B")
print("active before cleanup:", active_connection(store, "w"))
# A stale cleanup runs
cleanup_setup(store, "w", "A")
print("active after cleanup(A):", active_connection(store, "w"))
print("EXPECTED per README (cleanup removes only association it owns): connection-B")
'
